title: Iron Block's texture to Bedrock's Texture
description: A simple, lightweight resource pack that transforms the texture of Iron Blocks into Bedrock. Exclusively made for Minecraft 1.21.11.
body:
# 🪨 Iron Block to Bedrock (1.21.11)

Have you ever wanted your Iron Blocks to look absolutely indestructible? This simple, lightweight resource pack changes the default **Iron Block** texture to the classic, unyielding **Bedrock** texture!

Perfect for building pranks, secure-looking vaults, or just customizing your world's aesthetic.

---

### ✨ Features
* **Texture Swap:** Replaces the standard Iron Block texture with the 16x16 pixel Bedrock texture.
* **Highly Optimized:** Contains only the modified texture file, making it extremely lightweight and lag-free.
* **No OptiFine Needed:** Works completely fine in pure vanilla Minecraft!

### 🎮 Compatibility
* **Minecraft Version:** 1.21.11 (Optimized and tested for this specific version).
* **Format:** Uses the latest `pack_format` to ensure a green, compatible status in your resource pack menu.

---

### 🛠️ Installation
1. Download the resource pack folder or `.zip` file.
2. Open Minecraft (Version 1.21.11) and go to **Options** > **Resource Packs** > **Open Pack Folder**.
3. Drag and drop the downloaded file into the folder.
4. Activate the pack in-game and enjoy your new indestructible-looking blocks!

*Note: This only changes the visual appearance (texture) of the Iron Block. It does NOT alter its actual blast resistance, mining speed, or item properties.*
